chartToConfig.description:
Maps of chart IDs to UiSdlTimeseriesLineBarChart configuration. The UI Chart components should use
derivedProps to set their configurations based on the fields of a specific configuration in this map.

chartToDataTransforms.description:
Maps of chart IDs to an array of data transforms to run on the yAxisField data
after the default UI framework transforms. Every transform listed here MUST be added
to {@link ChartInfoTransformMap}.

title:
This type defines the configuration field that implementors of {@link ChartHelper} will use to store
the chart configurations to be used.

Enforces the return format for {@link ChartHelper#getChartConfigs}.
name: ChartConfigInfo
